stemMd: A membrane is permeable to a small uncharged solute. At equilibrium the solute has equal concentrations on both sides. Which statement is correct?

options.label: A
options.textMd: ATP is required to keep every molecule stationary.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Only molecules on the left can cross.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Molecules still cross in both directions, but there is no net flux.

explanationMd: Diffusive equilibrium is dynamic: random crossings continue in both directions at equal average rates. Equal concentration removes net movement, not molecular motion.

distractorRationale.b: Equal concentrations do not imply an oscillation.
